decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=READ, dst=PATH_REF{ (index=0xBEEF,generation=7) }, src=/cli/reply-ep, VALUE u32=9 } — the same operation after ONE bound hop: element 0 consumed, src grown by the inbound mount.
decoded.note: RFC-0024 §4.1. The dst shrank by exactly 8 bytes and the src grew by the inbound mount run exactly as a canonical hop grows it — the bound form changes how the address is spelled and nothing else about a hop.
